scheme_name: Self Education for the Construction Workers
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
other_conditions: The applicant must be a registered member under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
The applicant must have engaged in any building or other construction work for at least 90 days in a given year
Permanent Government Servants are not eligible for reimbursement
benefits_summary: Reimbursement of course fees for distance education and a ₹5,000 incentive for each degree earned.
